claims.text: everything the checkout is reached THROUGH. `now` is None when the component has vanished, and None never equals a recorded identity, so 'gone' and 'swapped' are the same refusal on purpose.

claims.text: Ordering is the whole defect being fixed, so it is spelled out: every check below is lexical or no-follow, and the returned path is the UNRESOLVED one -- callers operate on exactly what was checked.
claims.why: Code comments and implementation follow this ordering; returns target (unresolved).

claims.text: inside the manager's own root, and never the root itself.

claims.text: never the primary checkout, an ancestor of it, or anything in it.

claims.text: no symlink / junction anywhere from the worktree root down. Checked top-down and BEFORE any resolution: a reparse point at any level can redirect everything below it.

claims.text: only now is resolution trustworthy -- nothing at or below the root can redirect it. Re-check the repo relation on the resolved form so a root that itself sits under a symlinked prefix cannot smuggle the target back into the checkout.
claims.why: Code at line 902-913 resolves paths and calls _refuse_if_repo_adjacent and _is_within on resolved paths.

claims.text: it must actually be there, as a real directory (no-follow).
